description: This Java class models the <inline-jdbc> element in a configuration schema, encapsulating properties for inline JDBC configuration including connection details and pool settings.

classes.name: InlineJdbc
classes.description: A final class representing inline JDBC configuration details, parsed from an XML element, with validation and default values.

methods.name: getJdbcDriver
methods.description: Returns the JDBC driver class name used for database connection.

methods.name: getJdbcUri
methods.description: Returns the JDBC URI string for database connection.

methods.name: getJdbcUsername
methods.description: Returns the username used for JDBC connection.

methods.name: getJdbcPassword
methods.description: Returns the password for JDBC connection.

methods.name: getJdbcPasswordLookup
methods.description: Returns the attribute value for JDBC password lookup.

methods.name: getPoolMaxsize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the connection pool.

methods.name: getPoolMinsize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size of the connection pool.

methods.name: getIdleMaxsize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of idle connections.

methods.name: getTimeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis
methods.description: Returns the interval in milliseconds between eviction runs.

methods.name: getSoftMinEvictableIdleTimeMillis
methods.description: Returns the soft minimum evictable idle time in milliseconds.

methods.name: getPoolSleeptime
methods.description: Returns the sleep time between pool maintenance runs.

methods.name: getPoolLifetime
methods.description: Returns the lifetime of the pool in milliseconds.

methods.name: getPoolDeadlockMaxwait
methods.description: Returns the maximum wait time for deadlock detection.

methods.name: getPoolDeadlockRetrywait
methods.description: Returns the retry wait time for deadlock resolution.

methods.name: getPoolJdbcTestStmt
methods.description: Returns the test statement used for JDBC connection validation.

methods.name: getTestOnCreate
methods.description: Indicates if the connection should be tested upon creation.

methods.name: getTestOnBorrow
methods.description: Indicates if the connection should be tested when borrowed from the pool.

methods.name: getTestOnReturn
methods.description: Indicates if the connection should be tested upon return to the pool.

methods.name: getTestWhileIdle
methods.description: Indicates if idle connections should be tested during eviction.

methods.name: getPoolXaWrapperClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for the XA wrapper.
